Coverage is partial: the proximity search 0070C4A4-0070C795 is unread. docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md | Packet cc2_projectile_helpers, read-only analysis of the proximity search 0070C4A4-0070C795 and its tail. CORRECTION to the body range: it is 0070C370-0070CAD3, not 0070C370-0070C7AA. 0070C3E6 and 0070C400 jump to 0070C808, past the RET 4 at 0070C7AA, as do 0070C7C1 and 0070C7DE; 0070C89B then calls 0084C430 with the same eleven-dword shape as 006E657F. The last RET 4 is the three-byte instruction at 0070CAD1 and int3 padding runs to 0070CADF. The search: the squared radius is (segmentLength/2 + 2*classDesc[+70h])^2 at 0070C50F-0070C526, so the only fuse-radius source is the blast radius classDesc[+70h]. Candidates come from BSP_Recon_EnsureSlot([proj+54h], the owner's party index) and the intrusive list at slot+0DE8h (0070C52A), filtered by IsKindOf(5) and then one of (0Fh), (0Eh), (0Ch). The squared radius is clamped to 90000.0f at 00CFD508, so the search never reaches past 300 units. The nearest candidate latches [proj+288h] and [proj+294h] and sets [proj+28Ch] = max(0, [proj+290h] + dot(flightDirection, leadPoint - [proj+1DCh])). The lead point is 00901C20's, RET 10h: the four dwords pushed at 0070C656-0070C66E are ITS arguments, not 00427EB0's, which is a plain RET. The round bursts through 0070C210(projectile, 1) at 0070C79B once a step covers [proj+28Ch]; the expiry branch at 0070C3B5 passes 0. With no burst, 0070C7B6-0070C806 rolls 00BD2F10(0.0f, 100.0f) < 10.0f, a 10 percent per-tick airburst, once the miss distance has started growing and is outside 2500.0f. docs/PROJECTILE_HELPERS.md
